policies.title: Cancellation Policy
policies.content: Appointments can be cancelled or rescheduled free of charge up to 4 hours before the scheduled time. Cancellations within 4 hours are subject to a 25% service charge. No-shows are charged the full service amount.

policies.title: Refund Policy
policies.content: Prepaid packages are refundable within 7 days of purchase if unused. Partially used packages are refunded on a pro-rata basis minus a 10% processing fee.

faqs.question: Do you provide bridal makeup?
faqs.answer: Yes, we offer full bridal makeup packages including a trial session. Book at least 2 weeks in advance.

faqs.question: Can I cancel my appointment?
faqs.answer: Yes, free of charge up to 4 hours before your appointment. See our cancellation policy for details.

faqs.question: Do you accept walk-ins?
faqs.answer: We recommend booking in advance, but walk-ins are welcome based on stylist availability.
